title: “Kelly is a Warm Person, Joseph is a Role Model”: Gender Biases in LLM-Generated Reference Letters

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name and pronoun substitution in prompts (Context-Less and Context-Based Generation) to generate reference letters, followed by evaluating differences in lexical content (using Odds Ratio and WEAT for adjectives/nouns) and language style (using t-tests on formality, positivity, and agency). The paper also evaluates bias in model hallucinations using Natural Language Inference (NLI) to isolate and analyze hallucinated text.
